name: Sollux Captor
source:
First seen in Homestuck, Sollux is a troll that is befriended in Pesterquest Volume 9 alongside Nepeta.

Sollux is a tech wizard that enjoys video games. He's a bit sour and seems to have a high opinion of himself, but he has a good deal of affection for his friends.

[spoiler]His full first name is Solluxander.[/spoiler]
